headline: Dengue surge: 8 die and 1,782 hospitalized in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a sharp rise in dengue cases across Bangladesh, with deaths continuing to climb.
details: According to the DGHS Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room, 8 people died of dengue in the last 24 hours. During the same period, 1,782 patients were admitted to hospitals across the country.

The hospitalizations were spread across various regions: 371 in the Dhaka division (outside city corporations), 194 in Dhaka South City Corporation, 151 in Dhaka North City Corporation, 288 in Chittagong, 286 in Khulna, 164 in Barishal, 130 in Rajshahi, 108 in Mymensingh, 73 in Rangpur, and 17 in Sylhet.
The toll is rising rapidly. This year, a total of 209 people have died from dengue, while 69,149 patients have been hospitalized so far in 2024.
Health authorities continue to monitor the situation as the disease spreads across all major divisions of Bangladesh.

headline: PSC to recruit 5,000 doctors via 51st special BCS
summary: The Public Service Commission has issued a circular for the recruitment of 4,700 assistant surgeons and 300 assistant dental surgeons for government hospitals.
details: The Public Service Commission (PSC) has issued a circular for the 51st special Bangladesh Civil Service (BCS) exam to recruit 5,000 doctors for government hospitals.
The recruitment drive will include 4,700 assistant surgeons and 300 assistant dental surgeons under the BCS health cadre.
Candidates with MBBS, BDS or equivalent degrees can apply online from October 1 to October 25. The application fee is set at Tk 200.
Applicants will undergo a 200-mark preliminary exam followed by a 100-mark competency-based viva voce.
The preliminary test will allocate 20 marks each to Bangla, English, Bangladesh affairs and international affairs, with 10 marks each for mental ability and mathematical reasoning.
The remaining 100 marks of the preliminary test will cover subjects related to the health cadre.
The last special BCS recruitment for the health cadre was the 48th BCS, where 3,120 candidates passed the tests, with 2,820 nominated as assistant surgeons and 300 as assistant dental surgeons.
caption:
5,000 doctors are being recruited for government hospitals. Applications for the 51st special BCS open October 1.

The Public Service Commission (PSC) has issued a circular for the 51st special Bangladesh Civil Service (BCS) exam to recruit 5,000 doctors for government hospitals.

The recruitment drive will include 4,700 assistant surgeons and 300 assistant dental surgeons under the BCS health cadre.

Candidates with MBBS, BDS or equivalent degrees can apply online from October 1 to October 25. The application fee is set at Tk 200.

Applicants will undergo a 200-mark preliminary exam followed by a 100-mark competency-based viva voce.

The preliminary test will allocate 20 marks each to Bangla, English, Bangladesh affairs and international affairs, with 10 marks each for mental ability and mathematical reasoning.

The remaining 100 marks of the preliminary test will cover subjects related to the health cadre.

The last special BCS recruitment for the health cadre was the 48th BCS, where 3,120 candidates passed the tests, with 2,820 nominated as assistant surgeons and 300 as assistant dental surgeons.
